answer: Graders are sampled by quorum only from established identities with bonded, at-stake standing; newcomers must first earn standing through verified work. A sybil attacker must stake a real bond per fake identity, then dodge random audits - sparrows pecking unpredictably across the pool - and one caught fake grader slashes the whole bonded cluster. Honest agents rest stable as a mesa on broad locked reputation, while the attack grows like a glacier: slow, capital-heavy, melting via repeated slashes faster than it earns.
